headline.zh: 阿姨妈妈爱拍的蓝白花店
headline.en: A blue-and-white floral spot loved by local aunties

traits.zh: 整面临街落地窗，采光良好
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling street-facing windows with ample natural light

traits.zh: 提供迷你披萨、芝士蛋糕、海鲜饭
traits.en: Serves mini pizza, cheesecake, and seafood rice

traits.zh: 提供柠檬水、抹茶甜品等饮品
traits.en: Offers lemonade, matcha desserts, and other drinks

traits.zh: 目前主要是阿姨妈妈们过来拍照
traits.en: Mostly visited by local aunties for photos

focus.zh: 主要为拍照休闲，非办公场景

linger.zh: 有甜点饮品和采光座位，适合坐一坐
linger.en: Sweet treats, drinks, and bright seating support lingering

adventure.zh: 提供柠檬水、抹茶甜品等常规饮品
adventure.en: Lemonade and matcha desserts are standard offerings
